text:
maya: Quick pass on Compliance > Data settings UI — a few nits before we ship. KMS badge reads 'Encrypted (KMS)' and the tooltip is super long, wraps badly on mobile.
sam: can you paste the current tooltip copy? wanna see where to trim.
maya: current tooltip: 'Data encrypted using customer-managed Key Management Service (KMS). Learn more about key rotation and access controls in the docs.' — feels verbose for a hover badge.
rija: For screen readers we should avoid parentheses and abbreviations. Prefer something like 'Encryption: customer-managed key (KMS)' or even 'Encryption: customer-managed key' with 'KMS' included in expanded doc only.
ada: Accessibility flag: badge text contrast measured ~2.8:1 on the green bg — fails AA. Either darken the bg or switch to a 1px outline + dark text.
alyssa: Also noticed the badge is a small `<span>` with no role; it doesn't announce to SRs when focused. We need `role="status" aria-live="polite"` or an `aria-label` on focusable element.
maya: Proposed short copy for the badge: 'Encrypted — customer key' and tooltip: 'Encrypted with your customer‑managed KMS. Only users with key access can decrypt. See docs.' keeps intent but trims.
sam: +1 to shorter. Implementation notes: make badge a `<button>` so it can be keyboard-focused and then use `aria-describedby="kms-tooltip"` for the text. Example: `aria-label="Encryption badge, opens details"`.
rija: For SR clarity I'd change to `aria-label="Encryption: customer-managed key. Press enter for details"` — actionable hint helps keyboard users.
maya: Another thing: region selector ordering. Visual order: Region dropdown then Retention. DOM order is reversed, which breaks tab flow — discovered in keyboard audit.
alyssa: Repro steps: tab through settings in staging > hits retention first, then region. Fails expected flow. FWIW retention dropdown also lacks clear unit UI — shows '90' but no 'days'. Test case: 1) Enable retention 2) set 90 3) see logs showing '90' which confused security reviewers.
ada: Audit log copy: entries show 'Retention set to 90' — we should change to 'Retention set to 90 days' and include optional field for 'reason' if set by admin. Helps compliance exports.
sam: I can swap DOM order and wire `aria-describedby` in a small patch. Also will update badge to `<button>` and use the trimmed copy. Any objections to changing color to #006644 (darker green) to hit 4.5:1?
rija: #006644 looks good from contrast calc.
maya: For mobile tooltip we should convert to a bottom sheet on tap instead of hover-only. Tooltip text id = `kms-tooltip-191234` so we can reference.
alyssa: I'll add e2e test: keyboard nav order, SR reading for badge, retention unit display, and audit log line content.
sam: plan: PR today -> staging -> QA. ETA: patch up by EOD, run visual tests tomorrow morning.
deploy-bot: Deployment to staging scheduled by @sam at 1912345699 :rocket:
maya: thanks — I'll review the PR and check the keyboard flow after deploy. :thumbsup:
